title: Onboard elysian-lite-4b v1.0: perf profiles, metadata, and changelog automation
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: Add support for elysian-lite-4b v1.0 to the model registry with curated performance profiles and automated changelog/release-note generation. This PR includes: - model metadata (weights URI, tokenizer, architectures) - performance profiles for common sequence lengths and batch sizes - quantization recommendations and artifact tags - automated changelog entries generated via the existing changelog toolchain so release notes surface in the console/dashboard Context: elysian-lite-4b is a community model a number of customers have requested for latency-sensitive workloads. We validated baseline throughput on our T4 and A10 pools and generated perf profiles to recommend optimal batch/sequence presets. Checklist: - [x] Add model metadata JSON and registration manifest - [x] Add perf profiles for 1/8/32 token scenarios - [x] Add quantization/compatibility tags - [x] Wire changelog automation so a release-note draft is produced - [x] Add docs snippets and console metadata mapping - [x] CI: run unit tests, lint, and perf-smoke tests Changes are intentionally small; heavy artifacts (weights) are referenced by URI in the manifest. See files_changed for specifics. Related: ENG-4129 (onboarding initiative), PRs in redwood-model-registry for other model onboards for reference.

release_notes: Onboarded elysian-lite-4b v1.0: community 4B model optimized for low-latency workloads.
Added performance profiles for common seq/batch combinations and hardware baselines (T4/A10).
Introduced recommended quantization guidance and compatibility tags for Redwood int8 execution paths.
Automated changelog generation now produces a release note draft for model onboards, which surfaces in the Console release notes UI.
